name: observatory-guard
description: Keeps the Observatory prototype and its DLSS copy runnable while sessions edit them: checks each changed scene or demo script with Godot --check-only, refuses a copy of a broken script into the DLSS copy, refuses a DLSS-fork run with --fixed-fps, asks before a Godot window opens over the author's demo or a command stops it or their ComfyUI on port 8188; adds a /godot pane.
